profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in C++, Objective C, Swift, Quartz, iOS and Mac development and well know Java, Python, Bash. Interested in artificial intelligent, I am experiencing neural network, deep learning and image/video processing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Build and lead iOS team for Growth and Food-Growth family
* Actively build new features for the team while helping to maintain old projects and coordinating with other engineers to explore totally new feature for the app.
* Contribute to driving the team forward with project improvement, new project idea.
* Besides the project tasks, always seeking for engineer task for the team to make the code base better, well covered with unit test
* Contribute to the interview process
